name: HYDRA-UMC-SUITE
build: No pyproject.toml. __init__.py's __version__ is the real source. Packaged as standalone .exe using build_exe.bat/.sh.
notes: Desktop swarm command center, packaged as a standalone executable. Real server discovery (net/discovery.py): concurrent subnet /24 scan plus real mDNS (_hydra._tcp, matching what server.ts publishes and HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL already queries), deduplicated by (host, port). tests/verify_discovery.py gives the pure candidate-host enumeration and cross-source dedup logic real, deterministic, no-network coverage (this repo has no pytest suite - verify_*.py scripts are its own real testing convention).
